name: Subscribe Bell
summary: Flat notification bell with a red dot badge that swings to ring, for alerts and notifications.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 400 px wide at s = 1

params.name: color
params.note: bell colour; one darker shade is added for depth

params.name: anim
params.note: idle motion from p.f; swing rings it from the top

params.name: popIn
params.note: springs in over the first 10 frames
